newsitem.title: UK: NWE STRAIGHT-RUN STEADY, BUYERS AND SELLERS APART.
newsitem.headline: NWE STRAIGHT-RUN STEADY, BUYERS AND SELLERS APART.

text.p: Euro low sulphur straight-run prices were little changed on Wednesday with buyers and sellers still far apart while traders were mixed over the values of high sulphur Russian material.

Traders said most sellers of 0.5-0.8 pct sulphur material were at the $111/$112 mark, barring one seller who said he would do $113/$114 depending on quality. The little bids out there were at $106/$107.
"Levels are unchanged from yesterday. Most sellers are around $112 on an fob basis for lower quality material," one seller said, adding he would do $113/$114 depending on quality
